caption: Title page of Fischer Cárdenas's 1923 Bogotá medical thesis on yagé.
alt: Title page reading 'Republica de Colombia - Universidad Nacional - Facultad de Medicina, Estudio sobre el principio activo del Yagé,' with the thesis statement, faculty names, and the imprint '1923 Casa Editorial de "La Cruzada" - Bogota, Colombia.'
credit: Samorini Network (samorini.it) digitization of Fischer Cárdenas, Estudio sobre el principio activo del Yagé (Bogotá: Casa Editorial de "La Cruzada", 1923), p. 1
note: The only digitization of this thesis found is a modern plain-text retype (PDF metadata shows OpenOffice.org origin), not a photographic scan of the 1923 printing, so the page shows the title-page text reset in a contemporary typeface rather than period typography. No photographic scan of this rare thesis could be located online. Rendered as page 1 of pdftoppm output from the PDF.
